svg.text: Why Cp1 & Cp2 NEVER Corrupt Gain Vout = +(C1 / C2)·Vin!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Cp1 is driven by low-Z Vin in φ1 and shorted to GND in φ2 -> transfers ZERO charge to C2!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Cp2 is shorted to GND in φ1 and clamped to 0V Virtual Ground in φ2 -> ΔVCp2 = 0!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Feedback factor during φ2 amplification: β = C2 / (C1 + C2 + Cp2 + Cin,op).
